The foreground depicts three characters: two children and an adult. The tree stands high on a snow-covered hill, surrounded by a peaceful landscape. The sky above was a deep blue, and fluffy white clouds scattered over it, casting soft shadows on the snow.

On the left, a child wearing a red Santa hat, red coat and white pants runs to the tree with a green balloon. On the right, a snowman with a cheerful smile and a carrot nose, wearing a red and white striped scarf and hat, also runs toward the tree. Both children happily chased balloons floating above them, including a pink balloon with a white heart and a blue balloon with a white star. There is a small river in the middle

The ground is covered with a mixture of snow and pink grass, and purple lavender bushes add a splash of vibrant color. On the left is a white dove perched on a rock, and on the right is a cherry tree with pink blossoms.
